usage.text:
Usage: ot [options] <command>

Commands:
  daemon                       Start the OTheater daemon in this terminal
  backup                       Make a backup of the data now
  restore <folder>             Put a backup back (the daemon must be stopped)
  directives <action> [...]    Orders (the daemon must be stopped); actions:
                                 list, show <id>, add <text>, extend <id>,
                                 suspend <id> --scenario <s> [text], revoke <id> --reason <text>

Options:
  --data-dir <dir>  Data directory (default: OT_DATA_DIR, else the user data folder)
  -h, --help        Show this help
  -v, --version     Show the version

Options of "ot directives":
  --scenario <id>   Local order for this scenario (without it, add makes a global one)
  --kind <kind>     instruction (default), rule or suspension
  --role <role>     Only for this role (repeat it for more roles)
  --rule-key <key> --rule-value <value>   The configuration key a rule overrides, and its value
  --suspends <id>   The global order a suspension takes out of the scenario
  --replaces <id>   Revoke this order and put the new one in its place
  --from <date> --until <date> --for <duration>   Validity (YYYY-MM-DD [HH:mm]; 30m, 2h, 3d)
  --forever         extend: take the end away
  --reason <text>   revoke: why
  --all             list: also expired and revoked orders

Exit codes: 0 success, 1 the command failed, 2 wrong usage.
usage.missingBackupPath: "ot restore" needs the backup folder to restore.
usage.missingDirectivesAction: "ot directives" needs an action: list, show, add, extend, suspend or revoke.
usage.directiveNeedsId: This action needs the order id (for example O1).
usage.directiveNeedsText: "ot directives add" needs the text of the order.
usage.directiveNeedsScenario: "ot directives suspend" needs --scenario <id>: the scenario that stops following the order.
usage.directiveKind: --kind must be instruction, rule or suspension.
usage.directiveTooMany: Too many arguments for this action of "ot directives".
